overlap.color_space_assumption: Encoded RGB source-over ideal arithmetic over white; no inverse gamma adjustment.
overlap.explanation: 每个颜色Alpha时，先合成红到白，再把蓝合成到该结果，重叠保留红分量。组Opacity时，组内不透明蓝先完全覆盖红，之后组统一淡化，重叠只剩淡蓝。十六进制80等于128/255≈0.5019608，未恰好等于0.5。

experiment02_discrepancy.note: 保留真实差异。DSL确为Opacity(0.5)，任务要求同时报告理论与实际。未把该1.5差异冒充±1舍入通过，未改变opacity以逼近期望RGB，未修改PNG；服务内部原因未确认。

documentation.application: Whole subtree opacity applied after opaque blue replaces red; distinguishes group alpha from per-color alpha.
ImageFiltered reads child subtree; Gaussian pixels can extend beyond layout. Parser provides Gaussian output bounds automatically.
MULTIPLY can color transparent gaps within determined child painting bounds; cannot assume it only touches opaque content.
Square child produces circle; clipping must enclose complete filtered effect for experiment6.
BackdropFilter samples already painted background and needs explicit rounded clip; foreground text must be outside filter or child foreground remains clear.
